llm.summary: The skill is a coherent task-tracking loop, but it automatically persists task details and sends Telegram updates for broad classes of tasks without clear opt-in or retention controls.

dimensions.detail: The persistent planning file fits the stated autonomous task-loop purpose, but the skill also instructs automatic Telegram messaging with task results and file paths, which creates an external disclosure channel for arbitrary user tasks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation includes any multi-step task where autonomous execution is inferred, not only explicit Ralph Loop requests, and the rules say not to ask questions during a loop.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a markdown SKILL.md, no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or package code; static scan is clean and VirusTotal telemetry is absent.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: For arbitrary workspace tasks, verbatim request storage, progress logs, archived histories, and Telegram status messages are broader than necessary unless the user explicitly consents and sensitive content is redacted.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates /workspace/memory/ralph-loop.md, stores the original request verbatim, updates it throughout execution, and archives old loops indefinitely with no purge or retention policy.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the agent writing task details to a persistent workspace file and sending progress or completion details to Telegram. Avoid using it for tasks involving secrets, private repositories, customer data, credentials, or sensitive file paths unless the skill is revised to require explicit opt-in, redact messages, and provide retention or purge controls.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad inferred activation materially increases risk because persistence and Telegram updates can start without explicit user opt-in.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent task state is central to the skill, but retaining task content and archives is not clearly bounded or presented with user controls.
[SQP-2] expected: Progress updates are part of the workflow, but automatic Telegram delivery is under-disclosed and should require explicit consent.
[SSD-3] expected: Capturing the original request supports continuity, but verbatim persistent storage can retain secrets or confidential context unnecessarily.
[SSD-3] expected: Telegram status messages fit the update mechanism, but they can disclose task details without real-time review.
[SSD-3] expected: Including produced results and filesystem paths in the final Telegram message is purpose-related but over-detailed for an external channel.
[SSD-3] expected: Archived loop history supports continuity, but indefinite retention has no stated deletion or minimization control.
